concept_card.statement: A plane mirror forms a virtual, erect, same-size image as far behind the mirror as you are in front.
concept_card.analogy: Like a twin behind a window, copying your every step.
steps: Angle of incidence equals angle of reflection, from the normal
Image distance behind the mirror equals object distance in front
Step back and the image steps back too
So a full view needs a mirror half your height
concept_card.worked_example: Sita, 1.5 m tall, stands 2 m away: image is 4 m from her; a 0.75 m mirror shows her fully.

remediation_cards.wrong_idea: If I step back from the mirror, I'll see more of myself.
remediation_cards.why_it_feels_right: Stepping back from a window or a camera does show more, so a mirror seems the same.
remediation_cards.why_wrong: Your image steps back by the same amount, so light from your feet still reflects from the same spot on the mirror. The mirror covers the same part of you.
remediation_cards.correct_idea: How much of yourself you see depends on the mirror's size and height, not on your distance.

remediation_cards.wrong_idea: My image is right there on the mirror's surface.
remediation_cards.why_it_feels_right: The glass is the only thing you can touch, so the picture seems painted on it.
remediation_cards.why_wrong: Reflected rays spread out as if coming from a point behind the mirror, as far behind as you are in front. Your eyes trace them back there.
remediation_cards.correct_idea: The image is virtual and lies as far behind the mirror as the object is in front.

contrast_probes.probe: If you step 1 m back from a mirror, what happens to your image?
contrast_probes.reply_if_first: It looks farther away and I can see more of my body in it.
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: Nothing, it stays right there on the glass.

contrast_probes.probe: A small wall mirror shows you from head to chest. You walk three steps back. Down to where can you see now?
contrast_probes.reply_if_first: Lower down, maybe to my waist.
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: Still only down to my chest.

contrast_probes.probe: You stand 1 m from a mirror. How far from you is your image?
contrast_probes.reply_if_first: 1 m, because it's on the glass.
contrast_probes.reply_if_second: 2 m, because it's 1 m behind the glass.
